title: HAL test: Add coordinate boundary validation tests
description: Location tests use realistic GPS coordinates but do not test boundaries. Add tests for: (1) latitude_e7 = INT32_MAX (invalid), (2) latitude_e7 = 900000001 (just outside valid GPS range), (3) longitude_e7 = -1800000001. Implementation should reject these with -EINVAL.
close_reason: Added test_location_provider_rejects_invalid_coordinates to HAL test suite. Tests cover: (1) latitude_e7 = INT32_MAX, (2) latitude_e7 = 900000001 (just outside GPS range), (3) longitude_e7 = -1800000001, plus a positive test for valid boundary coordinates. Implementation already validates with valid_position_e7() in hal_location.c.
